meta.title: Summarise a paper
meta.tagline: Structured per-section summaries — background, methods, findings, limitations — anchored to verifiable page-cited quotes
meta.description: Reads each PDF and emits a four-section academic summary (background / methods / findings / limitations) with verbatim evidence snippets pinned to PDF pages, so every claim is click-to-verifiable in the result viewer.

entries.label: Study
entries.help: one distinct empirical study; single-study papers yield exactly one
entries.title: {study_id}

fields.name: study_id
fields.label: Study
fields.help: the paper's own label, e.g. 'Study 1'; null for a single-study paper

fields.name: findings
fields.label: Findings
fields.help: main results with effect sizes / significance exactly as reported

fields.name: limitations
fields.label: Limitations
fields.help: constraints and caveats; prefix '(implied)' when not discussed by the authors

groups.label: Summary faithfulness
groups.help: how closely each section tracks what the paper actually says
